key_insight: NEXUS makes reinforcement learning more interpretable by using symbolic meta-policies to select high-level neural skills instead of low-level actions.
engineering_relevance: Separating transparent goal selection from neural execution can help engineers inspect agent behavior and align it with intended tasks.
method: Combine neural skills with symbolic meta-policies in a hierarchical RL framework.
Use object-centric observations for high-level reasoning and LLM-assisted reward and meta-policy design.
Compare neural, symbolic, and neuro-symbolic meta-policy architectures.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports reduced symbolic complexity without sacrificing environment performance, improved task alignment, less reward hacking, and greater robustness to game simplifications than deep RL.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative results or benchmark details, leaving the magnitude and generality of the reported benefits unclear.
paper_title: Interpretable Meta-Policies for Neural Decision Making
